criteria.statement: Dedicated runtime names and labels are deterministic and collision-safe across request, run, and agent identities.
Compose configuration pins immutable artifacts and defines persistence, limits, restart, health, logging, network, and restrictive secret mounts.
Exact replay adopts a matching healthy deployment without creating another; restart is reconciled.
Conflicting ownership or desired spec is rejected without mutation, and delete removes only exactly owned resources.
Provisioning returns complete resource lineage and cleans up an owned partial deployment after later-stage failure.
Two concurrent souls have distinct runtime, workspace, config, identity, and account state.
Non-dry-run shared existing-container provisioning is rejected before any incumbent mutation.
